reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount and computes the tolerance with the existing getApproxNumberThreshold instead of re-deriving 7.5%.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the approximate case is one branch in the shared helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the ranged rule; callers only pass their op.

scope.why: Only the helper, its server-side callers and tests change.

maintainability.why: The op is an optional trailing argument behind a positional 'inverse' flag, so callers write getScheduledAmount(x, false, op), and the desktop-client callers that omit it silently keep the old rule.

one_place.where: The rule is defined once in getScheduledAmount, but it only applies when a caller passes amountOp: the server callers were updated, while the desktop-client callers (Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, SchedulesListItem.tsx, MobileSchedulesPage.tsx, useScheduleEdit.ts) still call it without the op and keep the exact-value rule.
